messages.content_text:
DAY 22  : 2 TRADES 2 BE

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
Bias was longs and there was an entry to be taken at 10AM but i missed it. Moreso, i wanted to see price retrace deeper into discount. It didn't happen and i missed the move. From then, i changed my bias to shorts as we hit discount of the whole bearish leg. Tapped a 5 min FVG and an SMT formed. Making NQ the heavier pair. I put my entry from an RB, I don't actually know how i set the trade. There should have been a breaker somewhere, but i must've been hallucinating. I must've flipped the OB's or something. nevermind i found the breaker. 15 second breaker aligned with 30 second OB. and OTE. Entered and price ran quite well, but retraced to stop me out BE. good risk management. Price ran to almost 5 R until retracing. May have used wrong leg for stdv.

Saw that it wanted to go higher, which means we are actually overall bullish. but i found a very strong reaction and SMT on ES's side from a 5 min FVG. Waited for the 30 second breaker to get close through and limited on discount. Price tapped me in. Because price was behaving strange and the nearest swing high was swept, i moved to BE. Price retraced from bullish discount and started moving up, breaking me even. Good risk management. 

I seem to always find myself trading in the accumulation. Or the opposite bias so my trade doesn't play out.

Psychological Analysis
First trade was good analysis and entry. Didn't do anything against my rules. Found the perfect entry for what it was. I hesistated on the 10 am trade cause it wasn't too sure and was still waking up. I do want to mention my mind isn't fully awake either. So with that acknowledged, i didn't rush into any trades. I reassessed the trade multiple times to be sure it was good. After first trade, i was a bit bummed, but i'm used to that happening. And it was correct as it could be. I'm always wondering if i should just shorten my TP's to lower RR's because it would run, but retrace midway. Just gotta stay patient and consistent here. With second trade, i knew i was trading in the chop zone, but -2 /-2.5 would have a retrace, so i took that on. It was a shaky play ngl, but the risk managment was quite good actually. Overall tired but not tilted or anything. There was good progress today on executions and patience. (edited)
